text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day as I'm walking through the
academy, I
notice a crowd gathered in a
hallway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow... She's incredible...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't even begin to describe her
aura.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: She's really amazing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's holding a press conference.
Here, take a
look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glancing into the room, I see Oguri Cap
in her
signature racewear being
interviewed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're ready to start
racing right
now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sure. When I put on my racewear, I
naturally feel
that way.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I think I can speak for everyone when I
say we're
all excited to see you run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll try hard not to let anyone
down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri really looks dignified in her
racewear,
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's soft-spoken, yet her spirit and
confidence
shine right through...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can see how her fans are drawn to
those
qualities in her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just thinking that I've still got a long
way to go
compared to Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I put on my signature racewear, it
feels
more like I'm wearing a costume.
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Mejiro Ryan isn't very
confident in
how she looks in her
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What? It's a bit early still. But I don't
mind, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oka—huh?! My racewear?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, I got changed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What?! You mean... in my racewear?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just told you that it doesn't feel right
on me at
all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her embarrassment, Mejiro Ryan
starts
running. But then...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm watching a real race! Go for
it, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
We're rooting for you! We know you'll
get first
place in your next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's surprising.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I could understand them cheering on
Oguri out
there. But me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I could understand them cheering on
Oguri out
there. But me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It does?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if I'm not at Oguri's level,
I've done
my fair share of running, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And people admire me enough now to
cheer me
on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Heh, so it's just like muscles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My daily efforts keep accumulating, and
people
are beginning to admire that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop putting all my heart into
running! And
I'll keep improving both my
muscles and my
racewear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yeah! I'm gonna run another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a new understanding that
admiration comes
with time, Ryan begins
running at full power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: They wanna be like me too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: Ryan! I've been watching you train!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
If it's okay, would you like to run
together? I want
to see you up close on
the track!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can't believe you guys!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
I've always admired how you look in your
outfit!
Please let me run with you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-okay! If you're sure you want to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll be off then, Trainer. Looks like
there's
no time to be gloomy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right! I won't put my racewear to shame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan starts running with all her
power—to
honor both her racewear and
the younger racers
who admire her.
